_meta._note: KRAFTON A.X K2 Raon-Speech 21B-A3B: bilingual EN/KO speech LM built on SKT A.X K2 Light 20B-A3B MoE backbone (21.2B total / 3.5B active), AuT (Qwen3-ASR) speech encoder + Mimi-style codec + Qwen3 Talker, 131k ctx, CC BY-NC 4.0. NEW model. Ingested the aggregate normalized Korean/English speech scores (x100): Raon-Speech KO 72 / EN 75 vs Qwen3-Omni KO 65 / EN 78, HyperCLOVA-X 8B Omni KO 60 / EN 68. NOT ingested: encoder/codec tables (reported as % relative to Qwen3-ASR/Mimi baseline = 100%, not absolute benchmark values); Raon-Speech + MOSS-Audio baselines (not in DB, baseline-only, no stub); single-model post-training numbers (tool-use 0.740, emotion/speaker 0.613, TTS error 3.1%) — niche. Card lists 46 benchmarks (LibriSpeech/KsponSpeech/VoiceBench/KVoiceBench) but per-benchmark WER/CER not in the card excerpt.
